issues.on_page: County sources 9,577 (= 2110 County fines and license fees, p7)
issues.issue: The only item is county fines and license fees, which could be fines and forfeitures. detail[6].detail_category (county/other local governments) is the same judgment call.

issues.on_page: School Nutrition Fund shown as a major governmental fund in Total Governmental Funds
issues.issue: The extractor rules list school nutrition as business-type, but this report presents it as a governmental fund. Keeping it governmental matches the report and the rule to use the Total Governmental Funds column (also receipts[9] and detail[91]-[100]). Defensible.
